blocks.text: A sound produced by the vocal cords with relatively little restriction of the oral cavity, forming the prominent sound of a syllable.
A sound that results from the passage of air through restrictions of the oral cavity.
A unit of human speech which often forms words corresponding to one opening of the mouth; a vowel and its surrounding consonants.
The set of letters used when writing in a language.
The Cyrillic letter **Ъ**/**ъ**, which in modern languages serves to denote a hard (non-palatalized) consonant.
The Cyrillic letter **Ь**/**ь**, which in modern languages using the Cyrillic alphabet serves to denote a soft (palatized) consonant.
